name: SkinVision
short_description: Mobile app that assesses the risk of a skin spot from a photo and advises whether and when to see a doctor. A risk assessment, not a diagnosis.
short_description_fr: Application mobile qui évalue le risque d’une tache de peau à partir d’une photo et te conseille s’il faut voir un médecin, et quand.
features: Photo-based skin-spot checks and a risk assessment from your skin type and risk profile; Body map and reminders, plus a seasonal self-exam assistant on the unlimited plans; Personalised advice on whether and when to see a doctor — a risk assessment, not a diagnosis; Single Check or unlimited 3-month and 12-month plans. Labelled Premium: no lasting 0 € plan was stated

name: Upheal
short_description: AI documentation tool for therapists that turns sessions into clinical notes, with a free basic tier and optional telehealth.
short_description_fr: Outil de documentation IA pour thérapeutes qui transforme tes séances en notes cliniques, avec une offre de base gratuite et une téléconsultation optionnelle.
features: AI session notes for therapists, with a lasting Free Basic plan for text, dictation and uploads; AI Notes adds unlimited video and audio notes, treatment plans and built-in telehealth; Optional AI Assistant Pro add-on; official trial without a card and a 30-day money-back guarantee; Only individual-plan prices are listed; group-practice and full EHR have no public starting price

name: Yoodli
short_description: AI roleplay coach for interview prep, public speaking and sales practice, with feedback on live sessions or uploaded recordings.
short_description_fr: Coach d’entraînement IA pour entretiens, prise de parole et pratique commerciale, avec un retour sur tes sessions en direct ou tes enregistrements.
features: Live AI roleplays for interview prep, public speaking and sales practice; Feedback on uploaded recordings; a user community on Pro; Starter is free with 5 lifetime roleplays; Pro and Advanced are billed annually at the verified monthly equivalents; Monthly list prices besides those annually billed figures were not extracted and are not listed

name: Big Interview
short_description: Interview-training platform with AI feedback on recorded practice answers and on resumes, plus expert lessons for job seekers.
short_description_fr: Plateforme d’entraînement aux entretiens, avec un retour IA sur tes réponses filmées et sur le CV, plus des leçons d’experts pour les candidats.
features: Recorded mock interviews with AI insights on delivery and clarity, plus AI resume feedback; Expert-backed interview lessons for job seekers; BootCamp by the month, Accelerator for three months, or Interview Pro lifetime; Official 100% refund within 30 days. Labelled Premium: no lasting 0 € plan was stated

name: Doofinder
short_description: AI site-search and product-discovery platform for ecommerce, with guided search, recommendations and quizzes.
short_description_fr: Moteur de recherche IA et de découverte produits pour l’e-commerce, avec recherche guidée, recommandations et quiz.
features: AI site search and product discovery for ecommerce, with voice search, synonyms, banners and custom results; Product recommendations and a quiz maker; visual tagging and visual search on higher plans; Basic, Pro and Advanced, monthly or yearly, in official euro prices, plus a free trial; The AI Assistant add-on and Shopify/BigCommerce-specific plans have no public price here and are left unlisted

name: Landbot
short_description: No-code builder for website and WhatsApp AI agents and chatbots, with a lasting free plan to launch a first agent.
short_description_fr: Constructeur no-code d’agents et de chatbots IA pour le site web et WhatsApp, avec une offre gratuite durable pour lancer un premier agent.
features: No-code builder for website and WhatsApp AI agents and chatbots, with a lasting Free plan; Templates, integrations and an optional WhatsApp add-on on your own number; Official EU euro list prices for Starter and Professional, monthly or yearly; BLACK NOVEMBER “Pay 6, get 12” is a promo, not the regular list price. Business is custom

name: Virtual Staging AI
short_description: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with a turnaround the site puts at about 10 seconds.
short_description_fr: Home staging virtuel en un clic pour photos immobilières, y compris le retrait de meubles, avec un délai annoncé d’environ 10 secondes.
features: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with an official turnaround of about 10 seconds; Unlimited renders and downloads, all standard room types and styles, no watermark; Basic, Standard, Professional and Enterprise, with the same official monthly rate billed monthly or yearly (12×); Labelled Premium: a free image-editing trial is included, but no lasting 0 € staging plan was stated

name: Meilisearch
short_description: Open-source search and AI retrieval engine with a managed cloud: full-text, vector and hybrid search, and a free self-hosted option.
short_description_fr: Moteur open source de recherche et d’extraction IA, avec un cloud managé : recherche plein texte, vectorielle et hybride, et une option auto-hébergée gratuite.
features: Open-source search and AI retrieval: full-text, vector and hybrid search; Free self-hosting, or a managed Cloud with a fixed monthly instance price regardless of search volume; 9 hosting regions, unlimited team members, no per-seat fees; Cloud officially starts at 18 €/month after a 14-day trial; the instance/region estimator is not copied in full

name: Weaviate
short_description: Open-source AI-native vector database with a managed cloud, a free-forever cluster, and a pay-as-you-go Flex plan.
short_description_fr: Base vectorielle open source pensée pour l’IA, avec un cloud managé, un cluster gratuit à vie et une offre Flex à l’usage.
features: Open-source AI-native vector database, with an official self-host option; Free Forever managed cluster, including embeddings and a Query Agent allowance; Flex starts at 41 €/month, pay-as-you-go, with no commitment; Premium is contact sales and has no public starting price

name: Twenty
short_description: Open-source CRM with agentic workflows: emails and meetings log themselves, calls can be recorded, and AI can take on CRM chores.
short_description_fr: CRM open source avec des workflows agentiques : tes e-mails et réunions se journalisent seuls, les appels peuvent être enregistrés, et l’IA peut prendre en charge tes tâches CRM.
features: Open-source CRM with agentic workflows: emails and meetings log themselves, calls can be recorded; Email and calendar sync (Google and Microsoft), lead enrichment, a custom data model and automations; Pro or Organization per user, plus official credit packs when personal AI usage runs out; Yearly totals besides a −25% toggle were not itemized and are not listed. Self-hosting is free

name: Chatwoot
short_description: Open-source, AI-powered customer-support inbox with live chat and a managed cloud, plus Captain AI credits on paid plans.
short_description_fr: Boîte de réception support client open source et IA, avec live chat et cloud managé, plus des crédits Captain AI sur les offres payantes.
features: Open-source, AI-powered customer-support inbox, self-hosted or on Chatwoot Cloud; Live chat and omnichannel inboxes; help center, teams, automation and voice on higher plans; Captain AI assistant with included credits on paid cloud plans, plus top-up packs; Hacker is free for up to 2 agents (live chat only); self-hosted plans are listed on the same official page

name: Langfuse
short_description: Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and observing LLM apps and agents, with a free cloud Hobby plan and a self-hosted option.
short_description_fr: Plateforme open source pour tracer, évaluer et observer tes apps et agents LLM, avec une offre cloud Hobby gratuite et une option auto-hébergée.
features: Open-source tracing, evaluation and observability for LLM apps and agents, with an official self-host option; Traces and graphs, session and user tracking, token and cost tracking, plus prompt and evaluation tools; Hobby Cloud is free with limits; Core and Pro add volume, retention and in-app support; Langfuse has joined ClickHouse; Cloud pricing remains published on langfuse.com

name: Helicone
short_description: Open-source AI gateway and LLM observability platform for tracing requests, with a free Hobby cloud tier and usage-based paid plans.
short_description_fr: Passerelle IA et plateforme d’observabilité LLM open source pour tracer tes requêtes, avec une offre cloud Hobby gratuite et des forfaits payants à l’usage.
features: Open-source AI gateway and LLM observability, with request tracing; Hobby is free with 10,000 requests/month and one seat; Pro and Team add unlimited seats, alerts, reports, HQL, then usage-based pricing; Team adds SOC 2 and HIPAA; On-page usage examples and startup / OSS credits are discounts or illustrations, not copied as list prices

name: Wooclap
short_description: Interactive presentation and audience-response tool for classes, trainings and meetings, with AI question and brainstorming features on Pro.
short_description_fr: Outil d’interaction et de présentation pour cours, formations et réunions, avec des fonctions IA de création de questions et de brainstorming sur l’offre Pro.
features: Interactive presentation and audience-response tool for classes, trainings and meetings, with 21 question types and live sessions; Self-paced questionnaires on paid plans; AI question builder, image labeling, question diversifier, brainstorming and follow-ups are included from Pro upwards, not on Starter or Basic; Official euro prices are billed annually, excl. VAT; monthly list prices were not extracted and are not listed

name: AppFlowy
short_description: Open-source AI workspace for wikis, projects and notes, with a free Personal cloud plan and a paid Pro plan, plus a self-hosted option.
short_description_fr: Espace de travail IA open source pour wikis, projets et notes, avec une offre cloud Personal gratuite, une offre Pro payante, et une option auto-hébergée.
features: Open-source AI workspace for wikis, projects and notes, with official Cloud and self-hosted options; Personal is a lasting 0 € plan; AppFlowy AI is only a limited trial on that plan; Pro unlocks AI beyond the trial, unlimited storage and members, at 11 €/member/month billed annually or 14 € billed monthly; A distinct self-hosted price table was not isolated from the Cloud view and is not listed
